composition_label: Structured extraction (Document automation) -> Feedback analysis (Customer insights)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.schema: fields: nonempty list of unique name, trusted Python regex pattern with named value group, required boolean
input.documents: list of unique id and text objects
input.feedback_config: text_field references schema; themes contain unique names and nonempty keyword lists

output.extraction: records: document_id, fields (value/source or null), missing_fields (field/required), complete
output.feedback: groups, themes with unique-feedback counts and supporting excerpts, skipped_documents, unclassified_group_ids, counts

shared_schema.source: document_id plus start/end half-open Python Unicode character offsets into original document text
shared_schema.validation: One validate dispatcher guards input, extraction, feedback and final output. Deterministic semantic revalidation rejects modified values, offsets, membership, counts and excerpts. Unknown object keys are rejected.
shared_schema.error: CLI prints exactly one JSON object with status error and error message; exit 2 for validation, file, decoding, malformed JSON and usage failures.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Feedback consumes only validated extraction records; required-field incompleteness skips the record; missing optional feedback and punctuation-only feedback have distinct skip reasons. Values and source spans propagate into groups and keyword evidence.

behavior.extraction: First regex match per field per document; trim captured outer whitespace and adjust source offsets. Unmatched, unmatched optional group, empty or whitespace-only captures are missing. Missing optional fields do not make a record incomplete.
behavior.deduplication: Global across eligible documents: casefold, extract Unicode word tokens, join with single spaces. Punctuation and whitespace variants deduplicate. Digits and underscores remain significant. Stable first-seen representative and group IDs; all source document IDs retained.
behavior.themes: Case-insensitive literal keyword/phrase matching with Unicode word boundaries against each original extracted feedback. Every nonoverlapping match per keyword is traced; each group counts at most once per theme. Themes may overlap; zero-count and unclassified themes/groups remain explicit.
behavior.limits: 100 documents, 20000 characters per document, 30 fields, 500 characters per pattern, 30 themes and 30 keywords per theme, 100 characters per keyword/name/identifier.
behavior.synthetic_example: Four invented documents: two duplicate feedbacks, one unclassified feedback and one missing required feedback. Expected 3 eligible documents, 2 unique feedbacks, 1 duplicate, 1 skipped.
behavior.ordering: Preserves input document, field, theme and keyword order; matches are source ordered within each keyword.
behavior.side_effects: CLI only reads its supplied JSON path and writes stdout; no files, caches, external calls or providers are required.

excluded: Live LLM or optional LLM step
caveats: Schemas and regexes must be trusted; Python re does not provide execution timeouts.
Deduplication is lexical, not semantic: case/punctuation distinctions can be lost.
Keyword matching does not interpret negation, sentiment or intent.
Offset units are Python code points, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

test_outcomes.cli: passed; one JSON object with status ok; expected example counts verified
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing file, missing arguments, malformed JSON, invalid schema, duplicate JSON keys, decoding failure and invalid regex repetition return JSON status error and exit 2.
